name: claude-code-studio
description: A studio for sharing Claude Code agents and skills across local and cloud environments, with an incremental-learning loop that compounds knowledge across projects.

plugins.name: studio-core
plugins.description: Shared agents, skills, and an incremental-learning loop (capture + recall of lessons learned).

plugins.name: studio-exec
plugins.description: An executive layer above the delivery agents: portfolio strategy, revenue validation, and independent assurance for running several projects as a governed studio under a fixed token budget.

plugins.name: cloudflare-mcp
plugins.description: Depends on Cloudflare's own official plugin, so it's pulled in automatically wherever this is enabled — local project, cloud session, or org-wide.

plugins.name: synology-mcp
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to a self-hosted Synology NAS MCP server. The server URL is supplied per-consumer via userConfig at enable time, never committed to this repo.

plugins.name: google-sheets-mcp
plugins.description: Adds Google's own official remote MCP server for Google Sheets (sheetsmcp.googleapis.com). Per-user OAuth on first tool use, same mechanism as cloudflare-mcp.
